note: v3455: Both prompts map an item name to N sockets, both parsers keep it, and the journal persists it - measured on the live ring, sockets is a deep-row key and 12 of 766 deep rows carry one shaped Lionheart 3. The sighting literal in read_names_lane was where it died: 0 of 138 sightings carried it, so vault_retro socket fold and its whole variants machinery were built and fed nothing. Now 11 of 138 carry a count across 6 named items. Also fixed a PRE-EXISTING crash in test_a_frame_label_is_not_an_item_location: _named_sessions grew a placed list and the consumer summed every value. A/B against HEAD proved it was not the sockets change.
